products.title: LDT Warinterest Nylon M4 AEG PMAG Tracer Magazine - For use with Glow Gel Ammunition
products.body_html:
Everyone loves tracer gels! It looks cool & adds a great theatrical feel to gameplay, or even just for kids & adults alike having fun plinking targets in the dark. Tracer gels are great fun & they elevate the fun factor x 10 & spectators get treated to a cool light show too. Glow gels provide an amazing visual spectacle if you happen to play at night or at darkened indoor fields. 

A glow magazine or 'tracer' magazine is an Automatic Electric Gel Blaster (AEG) M4 magazine. This magazine can be used anytime, with or without glow gels. Most of our team run Tracer mags for our AEG M4 Gen 8 gel blaster rifles. The UV lights are always working, but we don't always use tracer rounds. It is an additional feature if the opportunity arises to play night games. 

This magazine has a strip of UV lights inside the feed tube which constantly charge the glow compound. Each time you pull the trigger; all the gels are being irradiated by the UV lights which build up the gels to their maximum glow level. It's for this reason that a tracer magazine is always our pick over a suppressor style tracer unit, because the gels in the magazine are getting far greater exposure to UV before being fired through the barrel, meaning you get the most out of the tracer effect. 

 This magazine is suitable with all Glow gels. We use & recommend iHobby Glow Gels with all tracer magazines & tracer units for best performance. Please note: glow gels are not hard gels due to the phosphorous additive which has properties which weakens them. Just remember, their primary function is to visually indicate the trajectory of your gel balls for play in low-light conditions or in darkened Gelsoft Indoor Game Fields. 

Buyers Note: Currently all glow gel brands in Australia use a similar compound & all are basically an even playing field. Out of all the glow gels we've tested, the standout were iHobby Hardened Glow Gels, because they are slightly harder & are the brightest out of all of the glow gels in our gel ammunition range, these rated the best in all gels on the market as at January 2025:

Safety Notice for Charging LiPo Batteries

IMPORTANT: LiPo (Lithium Polymer) batteries are sensitive and require careful handling. Please follow these safety precautions to avoid risk of fire, explosion, or damage:

  1. Never leave LiPo batteries unattended while charging. Always monitor the charging process, especially during the first few minutes and last few minutes.

  2. Use an appropriate charger. Always use a charger designed specifically for LiPo batteries and ensure it is set to the correct voltage and current for your battery.

  3. Charge on a fireproof surface. Place your LiPo battery on a fireproof surface (such as a LiPo-safe bag or a non-flammable material) during the charging process.

  4. Never overcharge or over-discharge. Charge only within the specified voltage range (usually 3.7V per cell) and ensure that the battery is not discharged below the recommended level (typically 3.0V per cell). Overcharging or over-discharging can lead to permanent damage, overheating, or even fire.

  5. Do not charge if damaged. If the LiPo battery is swollen, punctured, leaking, or shows any signs of physical damage, do not charge it. Dispose of it properly in accordance with local regulations.

  6. Store safely. When not in use, store LiPo batteries in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight, extreme temperatures, or flammable materials. Consider using a LiPo-safe storage bag for added safety.

By following these safety guidelines, you can reduce the risks and maximise the lifespan of your LiPo battery.

Safety Notice for Charging LiPo Batteries

IMPORTANT: LiPo (Lithium Polymer) batteries are sensitive and require careful handling. Please follow these safety precautions to avoid risk of fire, explosion, or damage:

  1. Never leave LiPo batteries unattended while charging. Always monitor the charging process, especially during the first few minutes and last few minutes.

  2. Use an appropriate charger. Always use a charger designed specifically for LiPo batteries and ensure it is set to the correct voltage and current for your battery.

  3. Charge on a fireproof surface. Place your LiPo battery on a fireproof surface (such as a LiPo-safe bag or a non-flammable material) during the charging process.

  4. Never overcharge or over-discharge. Charge only within the specified voltage range (usually 3.7V per cell) and ensure that the battery is not discharged below the recommended level (typically 3.0V per cell). Overcharging or over-discharging can lead to permanent damage, overheating, or even fire.

  5. Do not charge if damaged. If the LiPo battery is swollen, punctured, leaking, or shows any signs of physical damage, do not charge it. Dispose of it properly in accordance with local regulations.

  6. Store safely. When not in use, store LiPo batteries in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight, extreme temperatures, or flammable materials. Consider using a LiPo-safe storage bag for added safety.

By following these safety guidelines, you can reduce the risks and maximise the lifespan of your LiPo battery.

Safety Disclaimer:

IMPORTANT: LiPo (Lithium Polymer) batteries are sensitive and require careful handling. Please follow these safety precautions to avoid risk of fire, explosion, or damage:

  1. Never leave LiPo batteries unattended while charging. Always monitor the charging process, especially during the first few minutes and last few minutes.

  2. Use an appropriate charger. Always use a charger designed specifically for LiPo batteries and ensure it is set to the correct voltage and current for your battery.

  3. Charge on a fireproof surface. Place your LiPo battery on a fireproof surface (such as a LiPo-safe bag or a non-flammable material) during the charging process.

  4. Never overcharge or over-discharge. Charge only within the specified voltage range (usually 3.7V per cell) and ensure that the battery is not discharged below the recommended level (typically 3.0V per cell). Overcharging or over-discharging can lead to permanent damage, overheating, or even fire.

  5. Do not charge if damaged. If the LiPo battery is swollen, punctured, leaking, or shows any signs of physical damage, do not charge it. Dispose of it properly in accordance with local regulations.

  6. Store safely. When not in use, store LiPo batteries in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight, extreme temperatures, or flammable materials. Consider using a LiPo-safe storage bag for added safety.

By following these safety guidelines, you can reduce the risks and maximise the lifespan of your LiPo battery.

Brief History of Colt Commander

Shortly before entry into the Korean War, the U.S. government was searching for a lighter pistol for military officers. In hopes of securing a lucrative federal contract, Colt created an aluminium-frame, 9 mm-chambered version of the famed 1911, having a 4.25-inch barrel (which just became known as the 4.3” size) Compact.

Unfortunately for Colt Firearms, the contract never materialised, but in 1950, Colt went ahead with production anyway, marketing the gun to civilian shooters as “The Commander.”

 The lightweight pistol, with snag-reducing rowel hammer and shorter barrel, should have been a huge hit with citizens, especially chambered in a more refined 9mm Parabellum option over the heavy recoil of .45 ACP Ammunition. The 9mm Colt Commander magazine also offered greater round capacity than its .45 ACP Big brother.  

 No, the original (lightweight) 9 mm Commander was anything but an immediate and overwhelming sensation in the shooting world of the 1950s.

 Of course, America’s civilian shooters and cops were basically revolver guys back then, and while wheelgunners routinely settled for shooting medium-calibre, non-expanding bullets, the semi-automatic crowd apparently didn’t. Many semi-automatic devotees were committed to the .45 ACP, thanks mainly to the original 1911. Back then, semi-automatics were most often loaded with full-metal-jacket fodder for reliable feeding.

 Another factor preventing the enthusiastic embrace of the 9mm Commander may have been the fact that the culture of the ’50s was a much more peaceful environment in which to live, at least as an individual. Nuclear attack, which was definitely viewed as a “terrorist action” as opposed to “workplace violence,” was a national concern, but mass shootings or personal encounters with international terrorists were not to be for two decades, until the 1970s, where it made the daily news across the US.

As such, there was no major push for concealed carry as being essential for personal protection. So Colt’s entering production of the Commander with its reduced dimensions and weight didn’t produce the same impact that it might have had a couple of decades later.

It was also Colts very first pistol to be chambered in the 9mm cartridge. Right from the beginning, Colt offered the Commander in .38 Super and .45 ACP, too.

Colt Commander Gel Blaster Description 

The Colt Commander Gelsoft pistol is essentially a shortened version of the classic M1911A1. The body of the pistol is completely made of Alloy, is quite weighty and is indistinguishable in weight from its firearms counterparts.

The controls completely emulate those of the 1911 model - double protection against accidental firing with a separate safety catch built into the lower frame.

Standard magazine eject button, trigger, trigger and slide stop lever. The model is equipped with a GBB recoil imitation mechanism, which sets the bolt in motion during firing.

The GE Colt Commander pistol runs on a green gas, which is refuelled directly into the magazine through the bottom filling valve.

Golden Eagle gas blow back pistols represent some of the best value and best bang for buck pistols proven worldwide as high performers and reliability well beyond their price tag, and these Gelsoft versions are no different!

products.title: NWell Webley .455 Co2 Gel Blaster Revolver Replica as used by WW1 ANZACs & seen in ‘Peaky Blinders’
products.body_html:
^ This item is restricted for sale in Queensland only – please see Gel Blaster Purchase and Shipping restriction details below.

The NWell Webley .455 is an absolute classic in revolver  design and the NWell gel blaster version is an excellent reproduction of the original. Fantastically rugged full metal construction with CNC shells to load your gels into, the Nwell Webley also has realistic function & capable of both single and double action firing exactly the same as the real steel version.

the Webley features a hinged ‘break open’ reload design. The cylinder does not drop to the side like most other manufacturers of the period. This is part of the reason the Webley gel blaster is one of the most powerful of all the current Co2 revolvers, as the cylinder is fixed in place at the front end on the barrel opening providing an excellent air seal compared to traditional designs  

This model is extremely authentic and will delight the most fastidious collector of WWI replica weapons, Peaky Blinders Fans & gelsoft players alike.

A particular sentimental historical Collector piece for The  Australian Infantry & Light Horse troops (WWI) & Australian Air Force (WWII) and deployed with Allied Forces as a sidearm during WWI, most notably in the Gallipoli Campaign, the Platoon Sergeant, Company Sergeant Major & Officers were issued Webley .455 Revolvers as it was the official active service sidearm in Australian & UK Countries at the time WWI broke out. 

My (Viper) Grandfather carried one as an Australian Air Force Bombardier deployed with Allied Forces in England during the infamous and deadly Pathfinder raids conducted over Germany. On one night sortie, He watched his Webley falling out of his holster in midair and watched it sail to earth along with a stream of bombs and prepared himself for disciplinary action for loss of a weapon. Upon return to the Base he fronted nervously up to the QuarterMaster, admitting what happened, the Quartermaster simply said “here you go” and tossed a brand new one to my Grandfather who just stared at the new Webley in his hands in disbelief, The Quartermaster said it was a common occurrence, in particular for bombardiers due to the nature of their duties. My Grandfather, Darryl, received the Distinguished Flying Medal for his actions during wartime service. 

Features:

  • Brand: NWell
  • Model: Webley .455 Gel Blaster Revolver Replica - G293A
  • Propellant: 12gm Co2 bulbs (no thread type). We use & recommend Puff Dino Co2 bulbs with added silicone to maintain your gas seals & o-rings while firing it. 
  • All Metal construction (except pistol grips).
  • One of the grips serves as a cover to conceal the Co2 Bulb inside the pistol grip. Co2 Loading is very quick & easy to do. There is a quick attach/detach tension clip to secure the grip to the grip frame of the revolver with the Co2 bulbs
  • Fire Modes; Single and Double Action 
  • Hinged break open reload function 
  • 6 x CNC shells 
  • Alloy inner barrel
  • Ammunition: 7-8mm Gel Balls
  • Gel Type: for maximum performance we use & recommend iHobby Orange Pack Ultra-Hard Gels, iHobby Blue Frosted Pack Ultra-Hard Gels or Goat Balls Original Formula

Safety Notice for Charging LiPo Batteries

IMPORTANT: LiPo (Lithium Polymer) batteries are sensitive and require careful handling. Please follow these safety precautions to avoid risk of fire, explosion, or damage:

  1. Never leave LiPo batteries unattended while charging. Always monitor the charging process, especially during the first few minutes and last few minutes.

  2. Use an appropriate charger. Always use a charger designed specifically for LiPo batteries and ensure it is set to the correct voltage and current for your battery.

  3. Charge on a fireproof surface. Place your LiPo battery on a fireproof surface (such as a LiPo-safe bag or a non-flammable material) during the charging process.

  4. Never overcharge or over-discharge. Charge only within the specified voltage range (usually 3.7V per cell) and ensure that the battery is not discharged below the recommended level (typically 3.0V per cell). Overcharging or over-discharging can lead to permanent damage, overheating, or even fire.

  5. Do not charge if damaged. If the LiPo battery is swollen, punctured, leaking, or shows any signs of physical damage, do not charge it. Dispose of it properly in accordance with local regulations.

  6. Store safely. When not in use, store LiPo batteries in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight, extreme temperatures, or flammable materials. Consider using a LiPo-safe storage bag for added safety.

By following these safety guidelines, you can reduce the risks and maximise the lifespan of your LiPo battery.

  6. Store safely. When not in use, store LiPo batteries in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight, extreme temperatures, or flammable materials. Consider using a LiPo-safe storage bag for added safety.

By following these safety guidelines, you can reduce the risks and maximise the lifespan of your LiPo battery.

products.title: Ausgel Armour Tech Hi-visibility White Pearl Gels for gel blasters
products.body_html:
Elevate your gel ball performance with Ausgel Armour Tech White Pearl Gels, the strongest 'milky white' gels available on the market today. Designed specifically for Gas Blowback and HPA blasters with a 7.5mm barrel, these gels offer exceptional strength and precision. The distinct white color makes them easy to trace, providing valuable feedback during competitive play, ensuring you can see exactly where your shots are landing.

The White Pearl Gels are slightly harder than standard Armour Tech White gels, yet softer than the ultra-hard Armour Tech Ultra gels, making them the perfect middle ground for players who want the right balance of accuracy, impact, and durability. Ideal for gel blasters under 300 fps, these gels are engineered to perform at their best when used in competitive settings.

Specifications:

  • Type: Milky White, High Strength
  • Recommended Barrel Size: 7.5mm Inner Diameter (for a 3.5-hour grow)
  • Compatibility: Gas Blowback and HPA blasters
  • Ideal for: Competitive play and tracer visibility

Growing Instructions:

  1. Pour at least 2 litres of clean water into your grow container, then add 1 packet of dry Armour Tech White Pearl gels.
  2. Allow gels to grow for the following recommended times:
    • 1 hour for 6mm sized gels
    • 1.5 hours for 6.9 - 7.1mm sized gels
    • 3.5 hours for 7.2 - 7.5mm sized gels
  3. Once grown, remove the gels from the water – they are now ready for use in your gel blaster.

Optional Step for Maximum Strength & Performance:

  • After draining the gels, leave them uncovered at room temperature for at least 1 hour. This allows the gels to harden as the polymer cures, significantly improving their integrity and performance.

Important Notes:

  • 48-hour use: White Pearls should be used within 48 hours for optimal performance, especially in Co2 blasters.
  • Storage: Gels grown for 3 hours or less should be stored in an airtight container. Gels grown for over 3.5 hours will swell to 7.5-7.6mm and lose some strength, so it's recommended to use them within the same or the next day.
  • Avoid Freezing: Freezing gels can make them brittle and less effective.

Caution: Always wear eye protection when firing gels. Gels may bounce back, so take proper safety precautions.

products.title: Rizer V2 AT1 Alloy Hopup for gel blaster rifles - For 'on-barrel' use (not for Threaded use)
products.body_html:
The Rizer V2 CNC Aluminium Hopup uses the ‘Magnus effect’ & is the industry best in class hopup. It is designed for players to help you achieve better accuracy & performance.

Constructed with a CNC machined aluminium body & Resin Tongues, it is universal, as there are extra sized hop-tongues in your kit which are compatible with the 2 most popular inner barrels available, with an external diameter ranging from 8.5mm - 9.5mm. These are pictured above.

Due to this, it is excellent for anyone not sure of what size your inner-barrel external Diameter is, you get 2 x sets of tongues & each size suits the majority of popular barrels currently on the market.

Colour: Black

Package Includes:

  • 1 x CNC Aluminum Adjustable Hopup Shell - for ‘on barrel’ use only 
  • 1 x set 8.5mm Resin Hopup Tongues
  • 1 x set 9.5mm Resin Hopup Tongues  

Installation Tip: When securing your hopup onto your barrel, it is very easy to over-tighten the grubscrews. This mat strip the thread of your inner tongues which are made of Resin*.

Hopup Installation: Follow these steps for a perfect fit every time without stripping the thread of the resin screw points:

  1. Tools required: 1 x Allen key 
  2. Hopup orientation: the ‘Top’ of your new hopup is the curved tongue, with the flat tongue always at the bottom.
  3. Pre-fit barrel Grubscrews: Do not tighten the grubscrews until you have the ’top’ curved tongue perfectly centered.
  4. Hopup Alignment: to ensure your gels always travel perfectly straight, the curved Tongue must be carefully centred prior to tightening the grubscrews. Otherwise your gels may travel in a different direction.
  5. Securing Hopup to barrel: With the Allen key, gently tighten the grubscrews to secure your hopup to the inner barrel, in a clockwise direction until it is ‘just giving resistance. That’s as tight as you need.
  6. Have a cold drink! That’s it, give yourself a pat on the back, you’re now an expert, enjoy! 

⚠️ Note: stripped tongues are not covered by warranty.

products.title: Double Bell Magnum Research INC .50 AE Desert Eagle GBB Gel Blaster Pistol Replica - TM Spec Version
products.body_html:
^ This item is restricted for sale in Queensland only – please see Gel Blaster Purchase and Shipping restriction details below.

The Desert Eagle is a model which has not had much attention over the years; probably due to Tokyo Marui making such an outstanding replica of it already that no one had needed bother… until now. The Double Bell Desert Eagle is built to TM Specification & this replica offers exactly the same experience as the TM Desert Eagle at a fraction of the price. Parts are also interchangeable as are the magazines. The gelsoft community refer to the Desert Eagle as the 'DEagle'.

The exterior of this pistol is constructed from a Polymer coated aluminium to an almost identical standard as the Tokyo Marui version, albeit with slightly different finishes to the plastics. The Polymer exterior is constructed around an aluminium frame to provide a stable platform which not only makes it very robust, it also provides added weight which makes this replica feel like a true beast in the hand.

The magazine is much larger than standard pistol magazines & are a direct clone of the TM ones, which means the magazines are interchangeable.

This is one big blaster! The Desert Eagle It is actually the largest semi-automatic pistol commercially made in the world. There are numerous revolvers but only the Desert Eagle hits the mark.

As the Desert Eagle has such a big slide, it requires gas assistance to generate enough power to cycle the slide to reload ready for the next round. We recommend 14kg gas. This is the very first GBB Pistol we've ever recommended 14kg Green Gas for!

Being a (let's face it, ridiculously huge) pistol which has been advertised overseas as for 'Bear Protection', It is very bulky & has a long slide travel distance due to the size of the ammunition used. As a result, the Desert Eagle is also very heavy, the barrel is fixed in place, with a gas assisted slide housing the Bolt Carrier.

With a functional gas system the GBB Desert Eagle gel blaster pistol replica basically functions like a gas blowback rifle more than a gas blowback pistol, by having a 2-stage gas system, which means when you squeeze the trigger, the gas is directed to both the gel chamber & to the bolt carrier assembly at the rear of the slide, to provide additional power to the nozzle assembly via the rear of the blowback housing unit (BBHU), to reload the next round into the chamber. It's for this reason this pistol is recommended to be used with 14kg Green Gas.

products.body_html:
Specially designed for any type of guns and models for spraying with camouflage color. By using fine grinding pigment, it creates an extremely thin coating with excellent adhesion and coverage rate.

Puff Dino Camo spray paint allows users to easily color their guns and models. With quick-dry paint, it shortens the process time.

  • Quick Dry: The quick-dry paint makes it easier to overlap colors when spraying.
  • Fine Coating Layer: Thin and refined coating layer.

Applications:

It is suitable for use on metal surfaces including gel blasters, real guns & models. For plastic surfaces, we suggest applying a base paint first to increase adhesion. Materials like Polypropylene (PP) or Polyethylene (PE) may not be easy to paint on).

How to Use

  1. Use sandpaper or another abrasive product to abrade the object's surface to ensure adhesion, especially if there is old paint coated on the object.
  2. We suggest cleaning with Puff Dino Spray Cleaning Naphtha to remove grease and dust afterading the object. Wait for it to dry before spraying.
  3. Use masking tape to cover parts that do not need to be sprayed and remove it after painting.
  4. Shake the spray can for 10 seconds to get a good mix inside the can before spraying.
  5. Press the nozzle and keep it 10-15 cm above the object when spraying. Try to maintain the distance and speed when spraying. Spray multiple times with thin layers to achieve the best performance.
  6. Leave 10 minutes between each spray.
  7. Repeat steps for additional coats of paint.

Legal Compliance: Transporting Gel Blasters in Queensland

Legal Requirements for Carrying a Gel Blaster in Public

In Queensland, it is mandatory for all gel blasters to be transported in a concealed and lockable security container at all times while in public. This includes travel between home and a gelsoft field, as well as the return journey. All gel blasters must remain securely locked in QLD Government STOP & THINK Legal Framework approved security containers or bags.

Mandatory Requirements for Secure Gel Blaster Transport

To be legally compliant, an approved container must meet the following safety features:

1. Full Concealment:

  • The container must 100% conceal the gel blaster and its components, including replica magazines that may be indistinguishable from real ones.

2. Strong Build Quality:

  • The container/bag must be fit for purpose and in good condition to prevent accidental exposure of its contents in public.

  • Clear or transparent bags are not permitted.

  • The container must be sturdy enough to remain secured while in transit.

3. Dedicated Security Lock Points:

  • The bag must include built-in lock points or an integrated locking mechanism.

  • It must have no other means of access except through a secure locking system.

4. Secure Locking Mechanism:

  • The container must be securely locked using a controlled lock such as:

    • Combination lock

    • Keyed lock

    • Password-protected lock

    • Biometric lock

Examples of Approved Secure Containers:

  • Rifle or pistol carry bags/cases (with lockable points)

  • Backpacks with built-in locks

  • Lockable hard cases

By securing your gel blaster in accordance with all applicable STOP & THINK Laws & Legislation, you ensure compliance with Queensland's mandatory regulations.

Disclaimer:

This information is provided as an advisory guide for ViperTac customers regarding product compliance. This does not constitute legal advice. Customers are advised to stay updated on Queensland's laws and regulations regarding gel blaster transport.

products.body_html:
The Ops-Core Future Assault Shell Technology Helmet, also known as the FAST helmet, is a combat helmet used by special operations forces and law enforcement organisations. The FAST helmet series is characteristic for its shell shape – ear cut geometry which extends critical coverage over the rear occipital bone without load carrier interference, and optimises weight distribution for increased stability, integration, balance, and improved comfort.

The helmet is distinctive by its primary design features including the various suspension and retention systems, and the ARC rails which enable mounting of helmet lights and cameras.

Features:

  • Double loop chin straps secure the helmet to your head
  • Eight holes on the top of helmet, breathable and comfortable
  • With the detachable soft pads, easy to clean, and comfortable to wear
  • ABS and PC shell with EPS lining, lightweight, strong and crashworthy
  • The hard foam blocks have softer foam pieces for comfortable wearing
  • Adjustable elastic belt to fit different head sizes, head circumference is 55 - 59cm
  • Mount in forehead and rails on two sides, to secure night vision, torch, signal light, earphone support, etc.

Colour: Black.

Safety Notice for Charging LiPo Batteries

IMPORTANT: LiPo (Lithium Polymer) batteries are sensitive and require careful handling. Please follow these safety precautions to avoid risk of fire, explosion, or damage:

  1. Never leave LiPo batteries unattended while charging. Always monitor the charging process, especially during the first few minutes and last few minutes.

  2. Use an appropriate charger. Always use a charger designed specifically for LiPo batteries and ensure it is set to the correct voltage and current for your battery.

  3. Charge on a fireproof surface. Place your LiPo battery on a fireproof surface (such as a LiPo-safe bag or a non-flammable material) during the charging process.

  4. Never overcharge or over-discharge. Charge only within the specified voltage range (usually 3.7V per cell) and ensure that the battery is not discharged below the recommended level (typically 3.0V per cell). Overcharging or over-discharging can lead to permanent damage, overheating, or even fire.

  5. Do not charge if damaged. If the LiPo battery is swollen, punctured, leaking, or shows any signs of physical damage, do not charge it. Dispose of it properly in accordance with local regulations.

  6. Store safely. When not in use, store LiPo batteries in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight, extreme temperatures, or flammable materials. Consider using a LiPo-safe storage bag for added safety.

By following these safety guidelines, you can reduce the risks and maximise the lifespan of your LiPo battery.

products.title: Polarstar Micro Regulator & USG Spring
products.body_html:
The Compact Regulator High Pressure spring is compatible with both first and second generation Micro Regs as well as the UGS and CGS systems. Changing out the spring can be done in a matter of minutes and will safely increase the output of your regulator to ~200psi while still retaining the ability to operate at 40psi.

Although some pressure gains can also be accomplished by shimming the original spring, changing the spring is more beneficial than the typical shim method. When a spring is shimmed, the whole pressure range shifts up so you lose your low end pressure range. By simply changing the spring's rate, the regulator still has the ability to operate at 40psi. Even though the high pressure spring will technically not allow the regulator to recharge quite as quickly at that low pressure in comparison to the standard spring, at conservative rates of fire it is not going to be noticeable.

Please note:

Output pressure will vary depending on the output pressure of your HPA tank so an SLP will produce a slightly lower maximum pressure than a standard 850-900psi HPA tank.) 

In the case of first generation Micro Regs, if your gauge has a maximum reading of 160psi on the dial that you will need to replace it with our 220psi gauge in order to use the regulator at higher pressure without damage to the gauge.

  1. Add 2.5 cups of water to every 1 teaspoon of dry gels.
  2. Wait 4 hours for the gels to fully grow.
  3. Drain the water – your gels are now ready to use in your blaster!

Optional Step for Maximum Strength & Performance:

  • After draining the gels, leave them uncovered at room temperature for at least 1 hour. This allows the gels to harden as the polymer cures, significantly improving their integrity and performance.

Storage Instructions:

  • Airtight Container: Store gels in an airtight container (drained) for up to 3 months.
  • Avoid Heat or Sunlight: Do not store near heat sources or in direct sunlight.
  • Avoid Freezing: Freezing gels can make them brittle and less effective.

Caution: Always wear eye protection when firing gels. Gels may bounce back, so take proper safety precautions.

** Note: Holsters have a commonly accepted (however not official) standard in the firearms industry in regard to levels of security provided by different holsters. See Below:

Level I Safety - There is only 1 x securing point for the pistol. Usually Level I will be comprised of either a finger or thumb safety button/release catch, this also applies to 'Tension Fit' holsters. The 'tension' is considered to be categorised as safety Level I.

Level II Safety - There are 2 x securing points, typically Level II uses either a thumb & index finger release system - both points needing to be activated at the same time to draw the sidearm. 

Level III Safety - There are 3 x securing points and this is the highest recognised level of safety with regard to International Standards. The 3rd safety level is the addition of a pivoting securing strap which sits directly across the back of the pistol slide & is controlled by the thumb safety release. Whilst both parts are connected, they are considered 2 x safety points.

Generally, holsters with a covered pivoting securing strap are most often a Level III Holster.

Safety Notice for Charging LiPo Batteries

IMPORTANT: Li-Po (Lithium Polymer) batteries are sensitive and require careful handling. Please follow these safety precautions to avoid risk of fire, explosion, or damage:

  1. Never leave Li-Po batteries unattended while charging. Always monitor the charging process, especially during the first few minutes and last few minutes.

  2. Use an appropriate charger. Always use a charger designed specifically for Li-Po batteries and ensure it is set to the correct voltage and current for your battery.

  3. Charge on a fireproof surface. Place your Li-Po battery on a fireproof surface (such as aLi-Po-safe bag or a non-flammable material) during the charging process.

  4. Never overcharge or over-discharge. Charge only within the specified voltage range (usually 3.7V per cell) and ensure that the battery is not discharged below the recommended level (typically 3.0V per cell). Overcharging or over-discharging can lead to permanent damage, overheating, or even fire.

  5. Do not charge if damaged. If the LiPo battery is swollen, punctured, leaking, or shows any signs of physical damage, do not charge it. Dispose of it properly in accordance with local regulations.

  6. Store safely. When not in use, store LiPo batteries in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight, extreme temperatures, or flammable materials. Consider using a LiPo-safe storage bag for added safety.

By following these safety guidelines, you can reduce the risks and maximise the lifespan of your LiPo battery.

products.title: iHobby Blue - Extreme Hardened Formula Gel Balls for Tightbore Barrels
products.body_html:
Step up your game with iHobby Blue Extreme Hardened Formula Gel Balls. These gel balls are crafted for serious accuracy and power, ideal for competition or high-performance play. Made with a frosted white, non-toxic formula, these gels are specifically designed to withstand gas-powered blasters with tightbore barrels, delivering unmatched consistency and impact.

  • Ultra Durable and Hard-Hitting: Perfect for tightbore barrels, these hardened gels maintain shape and precision for reliable, accurate shots every time.
  • Consistent Size & Speed: Each gel ball is crafted for tight size tolerances, optimizing performance for competitive players.
  • Frosted White for Enhanced Visibility: The unique color aids in tracking shots, even at high speeds.

Pack Details:

  • Contains approximately 10,000 gels (90g packet)

Growing Instructions:

  1. Soak gels in clean, room-temperature water for 1 hour 45 minutes for optimal size (7.2 - 7.5mm).
  2. For slightly larger gels, continue soaking in 15-minute increments, checking size each time until the desired diameter is reached.
  3. Once grown, remove the gels from the water – they are now ready for use in your gel blaster.

Optional Step for Maximum Strength & Performance:

  • After draining the gels, leave them uncovered at room temperature for at least 1 hour. This allows the gels to harden as the polymer cures, significantly improving their integrity and performance.
  • Avoid Freezing: Freezing gels can make them brittle and less effective.

Caution: Always wear eye protection when firing gels. Gels may bounce back, so take proper safety precautions

Package Includes:

1 x iHobby Blue Pack Extreme Hardened Formula Gels 90gm Pack

Safety Notice for Charging LiPo Batteries

IMPORTANT: LiPo (Lithium Polymer) batteries are sensitive and require careful handling. Please follow these safety precautions to avoid risk of fire, explosion, or damage:

  1. Never leave LiPo batteries unattended while charging. Always monitor the charging process, especially during the first few minutes and last few minutes.

  2. Use an appropriate charger. Always use a charger designed specifically for LiPo batteries and ensure it is set to the correct voltage and current for your battery.

  3. Charge on a fireproof surface. Place your LiPo battery on a fireproof surface (such as a LiPo-safe bag or a non-flammable material) during the charging process.

  4. Never overcharge or over-discharge. Charge only within the specified voltage range (usually 3.7V per cell) and ensure that the battery is not discharged below the recommended level (typically 3.0V per cell). Overcharging or over-discharging can lead to permanent damage, overheating, or even fire.

  5. Do not charge if damaged. If the LiPo battery is swollen, punctured, leaking, or shows any signs of physical damage, do not charge it. Dispose of it properly in accordance with local regulations.

  6. Store safely. When not in use, store LiPo batteries in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight, extreme temperatures, or flammable materials. Consider using a LiPo-safe storage bag for added safety.

By following these safety guidelines, you can reduce the risks and maximise the lifespan of your LiPo battery.

Safety Notice for Charging LiPo Batteries

IMPORTANT: LiPo (Lithium Polymer) batteries are sensitive and require careful handling. Please follow these safety precautions to avoid risk of fire, explosion, or damage:

  1. Never leave LiPo batteries unattended while charging. Always monitor the charging process, especially during the first few minutes and last few minutes.

  2. Use an appropriate charger. Always use a charger designed specifically for LiPo batteries and ensure it is set to the correct voltage and current for your battery.

  3. Charge on a fireproof surface. Place your LiPo battery on a fireproof surface (such as a LiPo-safe bag or a non-flammable material) during the charging process.

  4. Never overcharge or over-discharge. Charge only within the specified voltage range (usually 3.7V per cell) and ensure that the battery is not discharged below the recommended level (typically 3.0V per cell). Overcharging or over-discharging can lead to permanent damage, overheating, or even fire.

  5. Do not charge if damaged. If the LiPo battery is swollen, punctured, leaking, or shows any signs of physical damage, do not charge it. Dispose of it properly in accordance with local regulations.

  6. Store safely. When not in use, store LiPo batteries in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight, extreme temperatures, or flammable materials. Consider using a LiPo-safe storage bag for added safety.

By following these safety guidelines, you can reduce the risks and maximise the lifespan of your LiPo battery.

products.title: T238 Digital Trigger Unit (DTU) V1.7 Programmable Electronic MOSFET for Gel Ball V3 Gearbox
products.body_html:
T238 Digital Trigger (DTU) V1.7 Programmable Electronic MOSFET for Gel Ball V3 Gearbox.

The electronic fire control unit module is a programmable MOSFET electronic fire control module specially designed for gel blaster V3 gearboxes.

It features many personalised programmable functions such as piston homing, double stroke semi auto, multi-round burst, etc.

In addition, it also has the battery low-pressure protection and gearbox blocking protection function, which can effectively improve the stability, firing rate and response speed of the gearbox, and completely eliminate the problem of bursts to multiple round burst.

The working voltage: 7.4v-14.8v. The maximum capacity the module can use is 14.8v batteries. Soldering and wiring is required for installation.

Multiple shooting modes can be programmed.

Safe Mode: This mode completely the same as original safe model. The trigger is stopped by safety lever.

SEMI Mode: This mode can be programmed to achieve semi auto, double stroke single shot and 3-round burst to 6-round burst, the default model is semi auto.

AUTO Mode: This mode can be programmed to achieve bursts, 3-round burst, 6-round burst and 9-round burst, the default model is semi auto.

The maximum current it supports is 240A start current and 100A brake current
Suitable for XWE G36, JM 11AK and other standard V3 gearboxes

Specifications:
Material: Nylon + Electronic Components + Wire Rod
Product Weight: 70g
Package Dimensions: 16 x 16 x 4cm
Package Weight: 90g
Packing: Box

Package Includes:
1 x Fire Control Unit
1 x User Manual

Note: This product requires soldering and wiring. It is recommended that installation is undertaken by an experienced technician. Damage caused during installation by anyone other than an authorised ViperTac technician may void the warranty.
tags: T238 Digital Trigger Unit (DTU) V1.7 Programmable Electronic MOSFET for Gel Ball V3 Gearbox

products.title: T238 Digital Trigger Unit (DTU) Light Control Bluetooth Programmable MOSFET For Gel Ball V3 Gearbox
products.body_html:
The T238 Digital Trigger Unit (DTU) Light Control Bluetooth Programmable Mosfet is specially designed for gel ball version V3 gearboxes. With high-speed processor, 8 optical sensors and 2 high power MOSFET chips, this system has many individualised programmable functions, such as piston positioning, binary trigger, multiple-shot and so on. It also has the functions of battery low-voltage protection and gearbox block-up protection.

It can effectively improve the stability, shooting speed and response speed of gearbox, at the same time, it can completely eliminate the problem of gearbox single-shot become multiple-shot. The module uses a maximum of 12.6V batteries. Soldering and wiring are required.

Functions:

  1. Low battery voltage protection, the default setting is protection OFF. Change the battery when hearing '4~3~2~1' 4 beeps low voltage warning sound.
  2. Block-up protection. When gearbox Block-up occurs, the system stops working and emits an elongated '1~' beep. Please check the gearbox immediately by power off.
  3. Auto-loading function is designed for gel ball blaster magazines with motor inside, when changing the magazine, the magazine motor will run automatically for a period of time, and the length of time can be programmed by 9th option.
  4. This module is able to increase rate of fire, the stability of single-shot and make batteries have higher durability.
  5. The energy that support the active brake function comes from the inertia of motor, stop the piston without delay. The effect of active brake is significant on high torque motor.
  6. The active function prevents the over-spin of gears, this solve the issue that the single shot becomes multiple shot under high voltage. Meanwhile, the spring is fully released in semi-auto mode and parts in gearbox are not under strain, increase the life cycle of gearbox and parts.
  7. The system includes multiple shooting mode, these modes can be selected by fire select switch.
  8. The default position of the piston is adjustable in semi-auto mode. Pre-cocking function can be implementing, zero trigger delay.
  9. Adjustable rate of fire, the gap between two single shots can be programmable, to achieve adjustable rate of fire.
  10. When the DTU is overheated, after the trigger is pulled, the motor will give a beep prompt until it is automatically restarted after cooling.

Note: This product requires soldering and wiring. It is recommended that installation is undertaken by an experienced technician. Damage caused during installation by anyone other than an authorised ViperTac technician may void the warranty.
tags: T238 Digital Trigger Unit (DTU) Light Control Bluetooth Programmable MOSFET For Gel Ball V3 Gearbox

products.title: ASG Ultimate Mil-Spec AEG Performance Springs
products.body_html:
The ASG Ultimate Mil-Spec AEG Spring is engineered for serious performance and reliability. Manufactured from premium SiCr-treated spring steel, this spring delivers exceptional strength, consistency, and longevity — with minimal power loss over time. Designed for players who demand the best from their AEG, the Mil-Spec series represents the ultimate choice for consistent FPS and reliable operation.

Each ASG Ultimate spring is color-coded for quick and easy identification, allowing you to swap between power levels effortlessly between games. The closed and ground ends help maintain correct alignment during use, preventing bending and ensuring a stable rate of fire.

Why ViperTac Recommends ASG Springs Over SHS

There are springs—and then there are performance springs.

SHS Springs are solid, dependable options made from standard steel, offering a 1:1 compression ratio. This means the motor must use the same amount of energy to compress and release the spring, placing greater strain on the motor and gears.

In contrast, ASG Ultimate Springs are crafted from advanced SiCr (Silicon-Chromium) steel, offering superior tensile strength and elasticity. These springs feature a 1:3 compression ratio, meaning the spring requires only one unit of energy to compress but delivers three times more output energy on the forward stroke.

This advanced engineering results in:

  • Reduced wear on your motor and gears

  • Improved efficiency and firing consistency

  • Lighter, more responsive spring action

Key Features

  • SiCr spring steel construction – Lightweight, durable, and high-tensile for consistent performance

  • 1:3 compression ratio – Delivers more power output with less effort from your motor

  • Closed & ground ends – Prevents bending and ensures smooth, stable cycling

  • Color-coded ends – Quick and easy power identification between setups

Manufacturer: ASG
Compatibility: Most standard Gelsoft AEGs
Material: SiCr Treated Spring Steel

Package Includes:

products.title: Grenade - M26A2 - Twin Pack Spring Operated Gel grenades
products.body_html:
Gel grenades are essentially a bottle with an internal spring mechanism. When the safety clip is pulled and the lever is released, a sear mechanism is activated and allows three trapdoor-like hatches on the external shell to spread open, followed by the release of three spring-loaded hinged flaps underneath that "flick out" out any gel balls stored within the cavity between the hatches and the flaps, causing a "shower" of gels in all directions.

The gels are loaded in the base of the grenade after resetting the sides and putting the pin back in the lever. 

Gel grenades work with any gels, perfect for old or oversized gels as the grenade does not have any FPS requirements.

products.title: Ausgel Glow Gels - Tracer Effect Gel Balls
products.body_html:
Take your gel blaster games to the next level with Ausgel Glow Gels, the ultimate glow-in-the-dark formula designed for night games or close-quarter gameplay. These specially formulated gels emit a bright, neon glow when paired with a Tracer Unit, creating a mesmerizing tracer round effect that enhances your visibility and precision in low-light conditions.

Perfect for adding excitement to your nighttime battles, Ausgel Glow Gels are compatible with Tracer Units like the LDT Warinterest Tracer Magazine or the Acertech Spitfire to activate the glow effect. Watch as your shots light up the field with a dramatic glow, making it easy to track your shots and gain an edge over your opponents.

Specifications:

  • Average Size: 7.38mm
  • Average Weight: 0.23g
  • Crush Threshold (distance gel can be squeezed before breaking): 3.33mm
  • Barrel Compatibility: 7.2mm - 7.5mm
  • Glow Effect: Activated with a Tracer Unit (sold separately)

Growing Instructions:

  1. Add 2.5 cups of water to every 1 teaspoon of dry gels.
  2. Wait 4 hours for the gels to fully grow.
  3. Remove from water – the gels are now ready for use in your gel blaster!

Storage Instructions:

  • Airtight Container: Store gels in an airtight container for up to 3 months.
  • Avoid Heat or Sunlight: Do not store near heat sources or in direct sunlight.

Caution: Always wear eye protection when firing gels. Gels may bounce back, so take proper safety precautions.
tags: Ausgel Glow Gels - Tracer Effect Gel Balls

products.title: Gel Blaster Green Gas / Propane & MAPP Gas Adaptor for remote users - Best Seller!
products.body_html:
The Propane Adaptor V2 is made of high grade metal and has a silicone oil port to make lubricating the gas easier. The construction provides superior durability to plastic which is susceptible to breaking or cracking due to the chill impact of the gas flow through the adaptor.

This is a green gas adaptor for use with MAPP Gas or propane, which is readily available from hardware stores in Australia This adapter will thread directly onto these cannisters and is suitable for use with most gas blowback gel blasters that has a green gas magazine valve.*

This adaptor features a miniature silicon container attached to the side of the valve, so you can charge your GBB magazines whilst lubricating them with silicone all at the same time. A specially designed chamber is designed to allow the silicone to mix with the propane gas when not in use, whilst at the same time preventing the silicone from leaking out of the valve.

Package Includes:

1 x Propane & MAPP Gas Adaptor 

Please Note:

The nozzle of this adaptor is not compatible with magazines with extra large base plates eg; TTI Pistol Magazine bases.

Propane is extremely flammable and poisonous if inhaled in large amounts. Do not use indoors.
